backrooms.description: Escape the endless Backrooms in a fast-paced endless runner. Keep moving as the path continuously changes, dodge deadly spikes, rolling saws, and other dangerous traps, and react quickly to survive. Run as far as you can, escape the dangers behind you, and challenge your best distance!
